description: Certificate of lawful development (proposed): Change of use from dwelling (Use class C3) to small scale (6 bed) House of Multiple Occupancy (HMO) (Use class C4)
decision_conditions: <p>The proposal is therefore not a lawful development.</p>

<p>The submitted information does not demonstrate that the proposed change of use of the dwellinghouse (Class C3) to&nbsp;a House of Multiple Occupancy (HMO) would be for up to 6 persons (Use Class C4). Therefore, it has not been demonstrated to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority that the proposed development would be within the tolerances of Class L of Part 3 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended)</p>
